items.item_text: Valid CA driver's license required OR Valid Class A driver's license.
Current California Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT) license.
Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
Bachelor’s degree or applicable years of relevant practical experience
Experience working independently, and as part of a team under multiple deadlines.
Experience working in health/allied health training environment, including a high-level of competency in veterinary medicine clinical skills.

Under the direction of the Gourley Clinical Teaching Center (GCTC) Veterinarian, responsible for managing the GCTC, a 42,000 square foot facility within the School of Veterinary Medicine that allows for the teaching of anesthesia, ultrasound, dentistry, clinical skills, and surgery to the DVM students, using live animals and animal cadavers. The GCTC Educational Support Manager monitors the daily operations of the facility, including oversight of teaching sessions that are scheduled in the GCTC and their associated sessions at off-site locations. Ensures that animals receive proper care and that the facility is in compliance with regulations and guidelines set by the department, the campus, and government agencies. Provides direction to staff according to established policies and management guidance. Recommends changes to department policies and practices. Identifies risks and responds accordingly.
Strong project management, strategic planning, and independent decision-making skills.
Knowledge of University equipment inventory and purchasing policies.
Demonstrated outstanding computer skills to produce high-quality work using database, spreadsheet, and word processing software.

Knowledge of and ability to provide first-line support for clinical teaching technologies including veterinary medical equipment, Audio/Visual recording systems, and electronic equipment used in teaching.
Organizational skills to establish and maintain a working inventory of supplies and equipment.
Strong communication, leadership and collaboration skills to foster a creative and dynamic environment among a large, diverse staff of clinical, administrative, and technical positions.
